featured_reviews.name: Jitendra Meshram
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very bad experience with Heena Digital Photo Studio, which is why I’m giving them a 1-star rating.

I had ordered two 20x30 cm family photos with frames from Heena Photo Studio, Chembur. One of the frames had a small gap on the top side that needed minor repair. When I pointed it out, their response was, “We won’t repair it; if you want, you can take a full refund.”

I repeatedly requested them to fix it, but they refused, saying that after repair I might again find some fault and that this would go on forever. Such a negative and unprofessional attitude is disappointing.

I had also given them another photo order, but they refused to take that as well. I have never had such a poor experience before. They completely lack professionalism and do not know how to take customer feedback positively.

Despite my repeated requests, they kept saying, “We’ll refund your money, please get the work done from another studio.”
Is this how you treat a customer? They are literally avoiding customers instead of resolving the issue.

I was ready to give them more business with two big frames, but they refused to work. Totally hopeless service.

featured_reviews.name: Dev Kelkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went there to get a photo frame made of shri ganesh in urgency as had a flight to catch next day. They were very courteous,  patient and helpful. Infact I actually paid RS 200 extra in a hurry. They were kind and honest enough to send me an email informing the same and made sure to return it when i went to collect the frame next day.
Not to mention the incredible job done with frame. Awesome work. Would recommend them to friends n family.

featured_reviews.name: Kiran Shiroor
featured_reviews.review_text: The service was good and quick. The person understood my urgency and was courteous. The small studio is not easy to spot though. Best place to describe the location is at the entrance of a narrow alley between the BMC D-ward office gate (opposite St. Colombo school) and a mobile selling shop. Spotted it through Google Maps.

featured_reviews.name: Nirmesh Raghav
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hired PK Photography for our Game Changer program in Mumbai on 9th November and we are very much happy with the experience. The entire team was incredibly skilled, professional and attentive throughout the event. They captured every moment beautifully and delivered all the photos and videos right on time.

Their promptness, coordination and high-quality work truly stood out. We are extremely satisfied with their service and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and talented photography team.

Thank you for making our event even more memorable....

featured_reviews.name: Jeremy McKey
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience getting professional headshots done with Prabhakar. The process couldn't have been smoother -- setting a time, a session in his studio, discussing edits after. The communication was frictionless. I very highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Jessica Mahood
featured_reviews.review_text: The best experience! Super easy booking process, really enjoyable vibe in the studio, finished products are perfect. Would highly recommend for anyone looking to build their portfolio.

featured_reviews.name: Albert W
featured_reviews.review_text: Outstandingly professional service with the flexibility to tailor everything to your needs. The photos turned out fantastic! I highly recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience with Prabhakar Kumar (P K Photography). Despite it being a Sunday and on very short notice, he arranged everything quickly and handled the entire process smoothly. He was extremely patient throughout and delivered the edited photos within a day, which was truly impressive. I would definitely recommend P K Photography to anyone looking for professional and reliable photography services.

featured_reviews.name: Maria Alexandra
featured_reviews.review_text: Our photographer was amazing to work with! He is professional, friendly, and so easy to be around. He made the whole experience feel relaxed and enjoyable for both me and my husband. The photos turned out absolutely stunning, and they mean so much to us. We’ll treasure them forever. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Sayan Vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to get professional headshots. PK was very cooperative and available on a short notice as well

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Koul
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience shooting at this studio today! The team was professional, creative, and made me feel completely comfortable. Loved the setup and energy on set 👍🏻👍🏻
